The earliest of the nine Group X artists to receive an English‑Heritage Blue Plaque in London was **Percy Wyndham Lewis**.  
His plaque, placed at his former home on 61 Palace Gardens Terrace, Kensington, was erected in **1983**. All of the other members (Dismorr, Etchells, Hamilton, Roberts, Wadsworth, Dobson, Ginner and Kauffer) were commemorated with Blue Plaques in later years.
